problem: Can non-fresh self-growing LCEs be restored to their initial state for repeated on-demand self-growth?
mechanism_or_method: Swelling with solvent and transesterification catalyst turns LCE isotropic and enables dynamic covalent bond exchange, erasing growth history.
limitation: Only lab samples shown; reuse cycles limited and applicability to other LCE chemistries unclear.

problem: How does confined water mobility govern the stress generated during humidity-driven actuation of silk?
mechanism_or_method: Vary silk secondary structure to tune bound-to-mobile water ratio and relate it to force onset; critical ratio indicates chemical potential threshold.
limitation: Only regenerated silk studied; threshold generality to other biopolymers is suggested rather than shown.
decision_relevance: Guides tuning of silk structure for humidity-driven actuator design.

problem: How does interfacial bond strength vary across supersonic particle impact bonds and what controls it?
mechanism_or_method: In situ microparticle impact experiments with site-specific micromechanical tests; native oxide form dictates strength; contact pressure-based predictive framework.
limitation: Single-particle micro-scale experiments; transfer to industrial cold spray conditions not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs oxide management and impact conditions in cold spray and solid-state bonding.

object: additively manufactured Inconel superalloy surface oxides
problem: Can tailored surface oxidation give self-lubrication above 600 C in oxidative environments?
mechanism_or_method: Spinel oxide layers with low shear strength form during wear; DFT and thermodynamics predict oxide lubricity across Ni-Cr oxide space.
limitation: Lab tribometer tests only; long-term durability and real component conditions untested.
decision_relevance: Supports choosing oxide-forming superalloys for high-temperature sliding contacts without solid lubricants.

problem: Can a compact microrobot combine agility, low power use and robustness across terrains?
mechanism_or_method: Passively morphing wheels with bistable configurations from asymmetric bending stiffness of tentacle structures, driven by electromagnetic motors.
limitation: Lab terrain tests only; battery and wireless module add limited demonstration of autonomy.
decision_relevance: Informs wheel-morphing design for small inspection robots.

problem: Can a 0.95 mm continuum robot integrate imaging, precise steering and therapeutic operations?
mechanism_or_method: Optical fiber backbone with microscale 3D printing and magnetic spray enabling magnetic steering, wide-field imaging and multifunctional tools.
limitation: Validated only ex vivo; in vivo safety and clinical performance not shown.

problem: How does distorted, tortuous crack-front geometry enhance toughness in anisotropic heterogeneous materials?
mechanism_or_method: Local mixed-mode I+II+III fracture from twisted plywood orientation yields helical crack front; theory and experiments give nonlinear toughening law.
limitation: Demonstrated on representative model system; extension to real biological or engineered composites unproven.
decision_relevance: Sets microstructure orientation design rules for toughness amplification in composites.

problem: Can a kosmotropic aqueous solution replace NMP for cathode manufacturing while keeping performance?
mechanism_or_method: Kosmotropic aqueous processing solution for electrode slurry, with techno-economic analysis showing 46% lower manufacturing energy.
limitation: Abstract truncated; lab-scale cells, scale-up to industrial coating lines not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports switching from NMP to aqueous cathode processing for lower energy.

problem: Can combining flapping flight with a telescopic leg improve efficiency and payload at insect scale?
mechanism_or_method: Subgram flapping-wing robot with telescopic leg hops continuously, controlling jump height and frequency.
limitation: Relies on offboard power and control, so autonomy is not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Favors hybrid hop-and-fly locomotion for energy-limited insect-scale robots.

object: power distribution networks under climate warming
problem: How much does climate-driven temperature change raise blackout risk in distribution grids by 2050?
mechanism_or_method: Model integration framework linking temperature to supply, demand and infrastructure limits, then power-flow-based blackout risk indices.
limitation: Relies on scenario assumptions such as GDP growth and synthetic grid representations.
decision_relevance: Guides where to add distribution capacity and manage peak load before 2050.

problem: Can chiral dopant-induced COF membranes separate enantiomers of macromolecular drugs with high selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Chiral tartaric acid substrate induces CCOF-300 membrane growth; size matching and diffusion rate differences drive enantioselectivity.
limitation: Tested on few drug molecules at lab scale; scalability claim not demonstrated.

problem: Can NdFeB-based helical microrobots swim upstream in blood flow under weak magnetic fields?
mechanism_or_method: Two-photon printed molds with vacuum infusion of hard magnetic slurry produce programmable helical microrobots.
limitation: Tested in subcentimeter-per-second flow in vitro; physiological flow and biocompatibility not shown.

problem: Can aligned subnanochannel nanocrystalline membranes improve permeance, boron rejection and chlorine resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Space-confined interfacial hydrogen bonding assembles tetra-oligomer chains into 6 nm supramolecular nanocrystalline membrane; MD supports transport.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons tested for hours to hundreds of hours; large-area module performance unreported.

object: calcium silicate hydrate surfaces for CO2 sequestration
problem: How do interfacial interactions and porewater affect CO2 adsorption capacity in calcium silicate hydrate?
mechanism_or_method: Atomistic simulations of surface chemistry-mediated porewater fluctuations controlling CO2 docking.
limitation: Atomistic models of idealized C-S-H; no experimental validation stated in abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides cement formulation for CO2 uptake.

problem: Can PET waste be chemically upcycled by aminolysis into solid CO2 capture materials?
mechanism_or_method: Aminolysis of PET yields bis-aminoamide BAETA and oligomers that chemisorb CO2 with thermal stability above 250 C.
limitation: Scale demonstrated only at 1 kg synthesis; no process-level capture performance reported.

problem: Can a triboelectric textile sense voice and connect clothing to generative AI?
mechanism_or_method: SnS2 nanoflower silicone coating on carbonized textile maximizes charge density; deep learning classifies voice commands.
limitation: Narrow frequency range (80-900 Hz) and lab demonstration; durability and washability not stated.

problem: How can L-PBF nanolamellar EHEA achieve both high strength and ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Valence electron concentration guided Al19Co20Fe20Ni41 alloy printed by L-PBF; coherent nanoprecipitates, nanolamellae and nanovoids cooperate.
limitation: Single alloy composition; fatigue, defect sensitivity and scale-up not addressed.
decision_relevance: Supports eutectic HEA selection for printed structural parts.

problem: Can molecular diffusion in heterogeneous pores proceed orthogonal to the concentration gradient?
mechanism_or_method: Epitaxial layer-by-layer MOF with two distinct pore windows; mass uptake measurements reveal interpore diffusion routing.
limitation: Model MOF system only; generality to other porous materials not demonstrated.

problem: Do dynamic facilitation excitations and thermodynamic cooperatively rearranging regions both hold below the MCT crossover?
mechanism_or_method: GPU particle-resolved simulations and colloidal experiments identify excitations and CRRs; timescale separation suggests excitations accumulate into CRRs.
limitation: Model liquids and colloids; applicability to real molecular glass formers is uncertain.

problem: Can atomic layer deposition create ceramic membranes with tunable subnanometer pores for molecular sieving?
mechanism_or_method: Burn off carbonaceous species of varied size from hybrid alumina films to leave tunable subnanometer pores.
limitation: Lab-scale films; long-term stability and scale-up unreported.

problem: Can a wind-driven coolant circulation device actively cool permafrost subgrade?
mechanism_or_method: Windmill with phase-change-material clutch drives fluid through heat exchanger, shutting off when outside air is too warm.
limitation: Single site, two-year observation; cooling capacity and long-term durability need further testing.
decision_relevance: Supports active wind-powered cooling for permafrost embankment and foundation protection.

problem: Can perfect circular polarization of elastic waves be generated in an isotropic solid?
mechanism_or_method: Anisotropic medium induces coupled Fabry-Perot and quarter-wave resonance with exact 90 degree phase offset, supported by theory.
limitation: Crack detection benefit shown only in simulation.
decision_relevance: Could enable detection of arbitrarily oriented cracks in ultrasonic inspection.

problem: How do flow interactions organize or destabilize linear flight formations of flapping wings?
mechanism_or_method: Robotic mock flocks with force measurements and perturbations inform wake interaction model of spring-like forces and resonance cascade ('flonons').
limitation: Mock flocks in water-tank-like robotic setup; relevance to real animal flocks is inferred.

problem: Can Eu be selectively separated from complex mixtures like spent lamps under ambient conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Redox-active tetrathiotungstate ligands reduce Eu(III) to Eu(II) coordination polymer via internal electron transfer.
limitation: Demonstrated on lab batches of spent lamp phosphor; scalability and reagent recycling not shown.

problem: Can optical-quality MOF glasses be hot-imprinted into micro-optical elements?
mechanism_or_method: Remelting ZIF-62 glass against 3D-printed fused silica templates, with viscosity measured by ball penetration.
limitation: cm-scale lab samples; thermal stability and long-term optical performance not reported.

problem: Can a polymer reversibly tune thermal conductivity by strain and temperature over a wide range?
mechanism_or_method: Strain aligns amorphous chains and increases crystallinity while temperature modulates it, giving up to 14.2 tuning ratio.
limitation: Bench cycling to 1000 cycles only; requires mechanical stretching hardware in applications.

problem: Can gradient-based topology optimization with multiphysics simulation automatically design locomotive soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Topology optimization coupled with material point method simulation starting from a cube with cavity; two designs 3D printed.
limitation: Two simple gaits (walking, climbing) shown; sim-to-real gap and general tasks not addressed.
decision_relevance: Enables automated shape design of soft robots instead of manual limb design.

object: 3D printable liquid crystal elastomer double networks
problem: Can polymerization sequence control produce opposite actuation modes in the same LCE?
mechanism_or_method: Interpenetrating LCE and elastomer networks with one stretched before the other is polymerized, combined with 3D printing.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of actuation modes; force output and cycling durability not detailed.

object: FeMnCoCr multiprincipal element alloys in additive manufacturing
problem: Can phase metastability be used to refine grains and break epitaxial columnar growth in AM?
mechanism_or_method: Increasing Mn lowers FCC stability; thermodynamic modeling, operando synchrotron XRD and microscopy reveal solidification behavior.
limitation: Single model alloy system; synchrotron access needed and generality to other MPEAs unproven.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy composition choice for grain control in printed parts.

object: reduced activation ferritic/martensitic steel for fusion
problem: Can RAFM steel achieve high strength and high ductility simultaneously?
mechanism_or_method: Modified thermomechanical processing yields multiscale microstructure of nanoscale ferrite, tempered martensite subgrains and nanoprecipitates.
limitation: Irradiation tolerance not tested in abstract; only unirradiated mechanical properties reported.
decision_relevance: Supports thermomechanical route selection for fusion first-wall steels.

problem: How can thick-panel origami deploy into seamless surfaces without grooves?
mechanism_or_method: Modify valley-crease panels and extend adjacent panels; derive geometric motion-compatibility conditions and minimize number of top panels.
limitation: Validated with 3D-printed prototypes only; load capacity and actuation not addressed.
decision_relevance: Provides geometric design rules for seamless deployable surfaces.

problem: Can thermal annealing boost piezoelectricity of wurtzite ScAlN films?
mechanism_or_method: Post-deposition thermal annealing process raises piezoelectric response by 3.5 times.
limitation: Abstract gives little detail; device-level reliability and mechanism unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests annealing step for higher-performance acoustic resonator films.

problem: Can knitted prestressed topology make ceramic aerogels mechanically adaptable under thermal shock and cycling?
mechanism_or_method: Ceramic nanofibers integrated with textile knitting topology and multistable constraints dissipate energy and accommodate deformation.
limitation: Strengths are modest (hundreds of kPa); thermal shock durability only partly characterized in abstract.

problem: Can laser-induced thermal shock separate cathode from Al foil and boost metal leaching?
mechanism_or_method: Seconds-long laser thermal shock reduces oxides, increases surface area and creates oxygen vacancies before dilute HCl leaching.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; throughput and economics at industrial scale not demonstrated.

problem: Can dual conversion pathways improve electrochemical extraction of uranium from wastewater?
mechanism_or_method: PPy tunes W18O49 electronic structure creating built-in field and catalyzes H2O2 production that precipitates uranyl peroxide.
limitation: Tested in spiked groundwater at lab scale over hours.

problem: Can mid-infrared photothermal microscopy fingerprint protein and nucleic acid content of single viruses?
mechanism_or_method: Widefield interferometric defocus-enhanced mid-IR photothermal microscope detects feature absorption peaks of single virions.
limitation: Few virus types tested on a custom microscope; clinical applicability not shown.

object: graphene oxide interlayers for water adsorption
problem: How does GO interlayer structure govern water swelling and H2O/D2O selective adsorption?
mechanism_or_method: MD simulations of staggered stacking of flexible GO sheets, supported by in situ XRD, NMR and TEM.
limitation: Model GO structures; isotope separation performance in practical membranes not shown.

problem: Can nano-ordered hydrides in a glassy shell overcome the strength-ductility and magnetocaloric trade-offs?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrogenation forms nano-sized ordered hydrides dispersed in stable glassy matrix, raising yield strength 44% and plastic strain above 70%.
limitation: Single GdCoAl system; cryogenic refrigeration relevance and hydrogen stability not tested.

problem: What initiates organic-inorganic interactions and mass transfer in hot hydrous rocks?
mechanism_or_method: Isotope-tagged thermal experiments and in situ visual observation show water microdroplets and free radicals at 150-165 C enabling interactions.
limitation: Simplified model system (n-C20, water, feldspar); natural rock complexity not tested.

problem: Do lead-free chalcogenide perovskites exhibit piezoelectricity despite being centrosymmetric?
mechanism_or_method: First-principles calculations plus piezoresponse force microscopy on BaZrS3; loosely packed cell enables ionic displacement; polymer composite harvester.
limitation: Piezoelectric coefficients modest versus lead-based materials; harvesting output not benchmarked in abstract.

problem: Can rotaxane cross-links enable in situ wrinkle erasure and regeneration without network destruction?
mechanism_or_method: Dually cross-linked network with [2]rotaxane sliding and quadruple H-bonding responding orthogonally to acid and alkaline stimuli.
limitation: Chemical stimuli in lab films; speed and cycling durability not stated.

object: Fe foam catalyst for ammonia borane hydrolysis
problem: Can an amorphous-domain Fe catalyst give long-lived practical H2 supply from ammonia borane?
mechanism_or_method: Amorphous domains on metallic Fe foam form Fe-B intermediates lowering H2O and AB dissociation barriers; tested in fuel cell car.
limitation: Model car demonstration for hours; catalyst lifetime beyond 900 h and AB regeneration not addressed.

problem: Can a single coating provide scratch, smudge, antistatic, flexible and recyclable protection?
mechanism_or_method: Organic-inorganic covalent-ionic hybrid network from fluorinated silsesquioxane and cyclotrisiloxane with fluoride ions.
limitation: Lab coating tests; large-area manufacturing and long-term field durability unreported.

problem: Can printing give plain carbon steels properties comparable to ultra-high-strength alloy steels?
mechanism_or_method: Intrinsic rapid cooling in metal 3D-printing forms martensite/bainite directly; print parameters tailor microstructure.
limitation: Fatigue, defect and cost at production scale not addressed in abstract.
decision_relevance: Supports printing plain carbon steel instead of complex alloy steels.

problem: Can a vanishingly small optical singularity locate position and displacement with picometer precision in 3D?
mechanism_or_method: Singularity line technique analogous to plumb-line centroid location in optical interferometric systems.
limitation: Needs a stabilized interferometric lab setup; robustness outside lab not shown.

object: critical materials for power system transitions
problem: How do power generation sub-technology market shares affect critical material constraints under net zero?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario-based material demand analysis of nineteen critical materials under China's carbon neutrality pathway to 2060.
limitation: Depends on scenario and sub-technology share assumptions through 2060.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes which PV and wind sub-technologies to promote given gallium, tellurium and other constraints.

problem: Can stacking sub-100 nm alumina with aluminum make a thin hard coating tough, strong and ductile?
mechanism_or_method: Constrained alumina layers with ductile Al interlayers; in situ TEM and mechanical models show crack shielding and giant shear deformability.
limitation: Thin-film on-chip tests only; performance under real contact loading and thickness scaling untested.
decision_relevance: Enables use of alumina in coatings where brittleness under contact previously prevented it.

object: MOF nanoparticles sandwiched in graphene oxide
problem: Can nanoparticles be placed between GO nanosheets without surface pre-modification to protect MOFs?
mechanism_or_method: Ice-grain templating sandwiches MOF or SiO2 nanoparticles between GO nanosheets, shielding MOFs from acid, base and humidity.
limitation: Lab-scale powders; scalability of ice-templated assembly not shown.

problem: Can electrically driven phase transition actuators reach fast strain rates and high forces at low voltage?
mechanism_or_method: Water working fluid heated by flexible coil heater, fluid selection method and nonlinear control reduce vibration and lag.
limitation: Thermal actuation energy consumption and cooling cycle limits not detailed in abstract.
decision_relevance: Supports choosing phase-change actuators for low-voltage soft robots.

problem: How can TENG output stay stable when sensor network impedance changes?
mechanism_or_method: Impedance decoupling via a small fixed-resistor shunt circuit stabilizes combined impedance and sensor voltage.
limitation: Shunt resistor wastes some harvested energy; bench-scale demonstration only.
decision_relevance: Guides circuit design for TENG-powered multi-mode sensor networks.

object: Ni single-atom nanopore catalysts for reactive CO2 capture
problem: Why do reactive capture electrolyzers lose Faradaic efficiency above 200 mA/cm2 and how can pores fix it?
mechanism_or_method: Templated carbon-nitrogen nanopores with Ni single atoms confine and enrich in situ CO2 via non-electrostatic interactions.
limitation: CO Faradaic efficiency only 50% at 300 mA/cm2; durability and energy efficiency are projected.

object: untethered magnetic soft robots with embodied intelligence
problem: How can batteries, circuits and sensors be vertically integrated on magnetically actuated soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Deformation-resilient flexible batteries with magnetic field-enhanced cycling, vertically integrated with flexible hybrid circuits in a manta-ray robot.
limitation: Battery retention only 57.3% after 200 cycles; aquatic lab demonstrations only.

problem: Can transmission-geometry laser desorption with plasma ionisation image lipids and nucleotides at subcellular resolution?
mechanism_or_method: Atmospheric pressure transmission MALDI source with plasma ionisation and pre-staining enhances lipid signals tenfold, down to 250 nm pixels.
limitation: Custom instrument needing pre-staining sample preparation; throughput not reported.

problem: Can a pH-responsive self-adaptive adsorbent improve seawater uranium uptake and resist biofouling?
mechanism_or_method: CPAP expands in alkaline seawater for uptake and contracts in acid for desorption; photothermal and quaternary ammonium groups suppress fouling.
limitation: Capacity (22.3 mg/g) and rate remain low for economic seawater mining; marine durability unclear.

problem: Can hierarchical triple-channel macroscale adsorbents improve mass transfer for seawater uranium extraction?
mechanism_or_method: Bioinspired honeycomb with macro, transverse and micro channels; COMSOL simulations show faster laminar flow and higher effective diffusivity.
limitation: Uptake of 14.69 mg/g over 35 days still modest; scale-up and long-term marine deployment unproven.
decision_relevance: Favors macroscale hierarchical channel designs for marine uranium adsorbent deployment.

problem: Can a large-aperture ultrafast scanner give fast high-resolution 3D mapping of tissue compartments?
mechanism_or_method: Nonlinear processing and distributed beamformation over a 47 cm aperture with programmable high-channel-count scanner.
limitation: Requires specialized large-aperture scanner hardware; demonstrated on limited human limb scans.

problem: Can fused filament fabrication of polypropylene give accurate carbons with low shrinkage?
mechanism_or_method: Fiber fillers in polypropylene matrix retain macrostructure during carbonization, tuning density, porosity and mechanical response.
limitation: Lab-scale printed parts; application-level performance and size limits not demonstrated.

object: lanthanide ion transport in MoS2 angstrom channels
problem: How do lanthanide ions permeate angstrom-scale 2D channels and what governs selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Volcano-shaped uptake and permeability peaking at Sm3+ from dehydration barrier versus channel interaction tradeoff, supported by MD.
limitation: Single-ion channel experiments; mixed-solution separation performance not demonstrated.

problem: Can 3D confinement scaffolds spatially align LC domains for complex 4D microactuators?
mechanism_or_method: 3D-printed PDMS microscaffolds impose director fields calculated with Landau-de Gennes theory and validated by birefringence.
limitation: Microscale lab structures; actuation force and scalability not reported.

problem: Can through-thickness compression of inclined pores give dynamic transparency without enlarging the activation space?
mechanism_or_method: Cuttlefish-inspired 3D porous structure with inclined pores that close and open under compression of tens of micrometers.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; durability, large-area uniformity and building integration not demonstrated.
